newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE'S INTRACOM HOSTS ETSI MEETING.
newsitem.headline: GREECE'S INTRACOM HOSTS ETSI MEETING.

text.p: Greece's telecoms manufacturer Intracom will hosting a meeting of the European Telecoms Standards Institute (ETSI) to be held in Athens May 5-8, it said in a statement.
"Intracom is host to the ETSI meeting titled 'Pay Terminals and Payment Systems' which is held in Athens between May 5 and May 8." it said.
The goal of the meeting is to develop the European Standards for pay terminals, used in applications such as phonecards, synchronous pre-paid cards and payment methods in telecoms, it said.
Security aspects and standards for security modules required for accesing fixed networks using integrated circuit cards will also be addressed.
Industrial corporations and European telecom providers such as OTE which are members of the ETSI will participate in the meeting.
Intracom joined ETSI in 1989, it added. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
